omitted: OpenRouter has several hundred models, so this file is a representative sample rather than a full catalogue. The four entries use individual model pages (https://openrouter.ai/<slug>) that rendered reliably during this pass. The aggregate pages (https://openrouter.ai/models and https://openrouter.ai/models?order=top-weekly) and bulk API (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models) did not consistently return usable per-model prices, so they were not used as sources.

No batchMultiplier is recorded for any OpenRouter entry: the per-model pages publish no batch discount. Cache rates are recorded only where a model page prints a specific per-model figure (Cache Read since 2026-09-07; Cache Write for anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 since 2026-09-07 and google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview since 2026-10-03), never inferred from an aggregate claim.

The anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 entry above carried an explicit uncertainty flag from 2026-08-05: its observed rate matched Anthropic's own introductory rate rather than the standard rate then scheduled for 2026-09-01. Withdrawn on 2026-09-07 - Anthropic cancelled that increase, so the observed rate is the standard rate. The entry's notes record why the flag existed and why it went.

Still four models by design (re-checked 2026-10-03), not OpenRouter's full proxy catalogue. Models added elsewhere in this pass (openai/gpt-6-astra, google/gemini-3.8-flash and the like) were not looked up on OpenRouter, so none is recorded here - a per-slug fetch each, deferred rather than guessed from the first-party rate.
